intro: For over 100 years, CCC has been called to make disciples, reach the lost in Omaha, and send the gospel around the world. Reach One More gave that calling fresh expression for a new generation.
archiveNote: **Reach One More launched in fall 2023** and ran through December 2024. This page explains what it was and why it still shapes who we are.
heading: There is always one more.
text: Reach One More is an evangelistic initiative built on a value CCC has held for a century. A friend. A neighbor. Someone in a hard-to-reach place who has never heard the name of Jesus.
verse: And the Lord added to their number daily those who were being saved.
